command: node scripts/ai-continue-batch.mjs --branches docs/quality/evidence/ai-s8-advance-2026-11-17/branches.jsonl --variant v90=heuristic --variant unfunded=heuristic:docs/quality/evidence/ai-s8-advance-2026-11-17/unfunded-weights.json --opponent heuristic@artifacts/ai-promotion/frozen-v90-standard/dist --dice 4 --horizons 1 --jobs 10 --out-dir artifacts/ai-s8/advance; python3 scripts/ai-continue-compare.py artifacts/ai-s8/advance/*.jsonl --baseline v90 --by-style --cluster-by-map --metrics margin.vp,margin.objectives,margin.killLoss,loss,own.outOfTrace
continuations: 68 branches x 4 dice x 2 variants = 544, about 1.8 hours
measure: margin.vp at the end of the game, unfunded - v90, dice averaged per branch, SE over maps; the two map styles reported and weighted equally. VP is the primary measure; objectives margin, Kill - Loss, the attacker's steps lost and its units out of trace are reported
reading: advanceUnfunded raises VP if mean - 2.1 SE > 0 (all cells equally): it then goes into the next attack-engagement candidate; lowers it if mean + 2.1 SE < 0: it is recorded as tried and not used; otherwise it is not established and is not used
powerAnalysis: A single continuation's VP difference has an SD of 6 to 11 (S5.2); 68 branches x 4 dice give an SE of about 0.6 to 0.8, so an effect of about 1.5 VP an event is established. The event happens 0.43 times a game. Below that the result is reported as not established
limits: The decision is taken with fresh step memory at the branch, for both variants alike
